svg.aria-label: Tile 2A: a keyboard, lower C4 held and upper E4 moving to F4. Tile 2B: a keyboard, lower C4 moving to D4 and upper E4 moving to F4. Tile 2C: a 36-second two-lane timeline with the upper voice resting between three short notes. No interval names are given.
svg.title: Three lessons in miniature

g.text: How to read this graphic: Each tile is a tiny version of a picture you will meet in that
lesson. Only the shapes matter here: circles and squares are the lower and upper voice,
dashed shapes show where a voice started, and the dashed boxes in the third tile are
